sentences.text: 1 Bonnie, Cherry and Julian are discussing a work schedule to carry out the research on World Expos.
Listen to the conversation and complete the note sheet below.
The first one has been provided as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the OK,
I know you've started doing some work for this World Exposed presentation we have to do, So I just wanted to check where we are and maybe plan out the next few weeks.
Yeah, I was thinking the same.
Jasmine has - Hold on, Hold on, What was it about again?
Right.
And is it?
The presentation Well, that’s what I was going to say.
Jasmine’s now confirmed all the details.
So we're presenting on August the 30th.
At Houghpass 9 OK.
Right. August 30th.
at half past 9.
That’s early then!
Wait, is that all three of Us presenting?
Yeah, that’s what we agreed on.
OK, just checking.
And who are we presenting to?
Do you never pay attention?
we are presenting to all the department heads All the department heads!
Wow, no pressure there then!
And where are we presenting?
The boardroom You know the big room on on the top floor with the wheel and.
Yeah, yeah, I know where the boardroom is.
Well, we'd better get going then, How much do we need to get ready?
I mean, how long does it have to be?
Well, all three of us will be doing a section.
So, I think if we do 5 PowerPoint slides each.
Yeah, that’s what I was thinking.
5 slides each, Which is fifteen PowerPoint slides in total So, just to confirm what were the three sections again?
You were joking aren't you?
Right, I can see you are not, Right, well Bonnie is going to look at the history of World Expos.
Oh, I thought you were doing the history of World Expos!
No, that’s Bonnie doing that.
You are looking at the good and bad things about World Expos.
yeah, I remember Jasmine did say she wanted us to find the bad things as well as the good.
So, what are you doing, Sherry?
I'm looking at the future of World Expos, remember?
We already read a bit on the future of World Expos online on the webpage.
page. Oh, yeah, OK.
I remember. Right, so what I wanted to do today was to draw up a work schedule, You know, so we know who's doing what and when OK, maybe I can take notes and send you it later Oh, I
was going to say, I was speaking to a friend of mine Leo yeah, of course Well, Leo told me his dad worked on the Shanghai Expo
in 2010 so I've arranged to meet up with him, his dad, I mean, and interview him.
Fantastic so when are you meeting him?
Oh, I can’t remember.
It was either the 8th or 9th of August.
Something like that So, which was it?
We're trying to do a schedule here.
Right, let me check my phone, Right, the Wednesday.
Hold on. So you're interviewing Mr.
Roy on Wednesday the 9th of August.
Is his surname spelled R -O -Y?
Yes it is.
You were pretty sure about that!
Hey did you read the email from Jasmine, she said that a Professor learned at the Hong Kong Metropolitan University is giving a talk about World Expos.
One of us should go.
Do you know when that is?
I think she said Saturday morning on 19th August.
I can't go to it.
Bonnie, why don't you go?
You could see if we can include some of the information in our presentation on the 30th.
Yeah, great! Okay, I'll make a note of that.
A talk on Expos at the Metropolitan University, on Saturday the 19th.
Great. So, I think we should meet up at some point to talk about all the information we've collected, Good idea.
When it be a good time for you?
How about Monday to 21st?
No, it's a public holiday, remember?
How about the day after the: public holiday then?
For what? Sorry, I was miles away.
For the progress meeting.
Yeah, fine, yeah, Yeah, me too.
well, then I'm happy to take all the information and do a first draft of the PowerPoint presentation if you like.
Fantastic thanks, Sherry.
When do you think you can get the first draft of the PowerPoint presentation done by?
Jasmine said she definitely have to see it beforehand.
hand. I can give a first draft to Jasmine on the 23rd.
It will take me a few hours to put it all together.
Okay. Give Jasmine the first draft of the PowerPoint presentation on the 23rd of: August.
Great. Could we practice the presentation sometime around about them?
How about doing it on Saturday 26th?
All of us will need to do it.
Would that be okay?
Yeah, that’s fine with me Fantastic.
Is that fine with you, Julian?
Sure. No problem.
Great Looks like we are very organized.
